name: 同花顺
text:
#!name=同花顺
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/adm\.10jqka\.com\.cn\/interface\/ad\/recommend/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/iphone\.ac\.qq\.com\/.*\/Support\/(getSystemConf|bootScreen)/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/stat\.10jqka\.com\.cn\/q\?ld=mobile&id=ad/i then reject_dict(200)

[Rule]
DOMAIN, adm.10jqka.com.cn,REJECT
DOMAIN, stat.10jqka.com.cn,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, ad.thsi.cn,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% adm.10jqka.com.cn, iphone.ac.qq.com, stat.10jqka.com.cn
